# University of Florida Catalog

> Comprehensive academic catalog for University of Florida undergraduate programs, courses, policies, and degree requirements across 14 colleges and schools.

The University of Florida Catalog serves as the authoritative source for undergraduate academic information, including degree programs, course offerings, admission requirements, and academic regulations. It provides students and advisors with essential information for academic planning and policy compliance.

## Key Topics

- Undergraduate Programs
- Degree Requirements
- Academic Regulations
- Course Catalog
- Colleges and Schools
- Admission Requirements
- Academic Advising
- GPA and Grading
- FERPA Student Records
- Academic Calendar
- Majors and Minors
- Course Search
- Registration Deadlines
- Bachelor Degrees
- Fisher School of Accounting

## Academic Programs and Degrees

- [Colleges and Schools](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/colleges-schools): Directory of UF's 14 colleges and schools offering undergraduate programs
- [Undergraduate Programs](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/programs): Comprehensive directory of UF undergraduate degree majors and minors
- [Departments and Schools](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/academic-programs/departments): UF departments and schools with curriculum and contact information

## Courses and Course Discovery

- [Courses](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/courses): Comprehensive catalog of UF undergraduate courses across all disciplines
- [Course Search](https://catalog.ufl.edu/course-search): Course search tool for discovering UF undergraduate courses by subject

## Admission and Registration

- [Admission](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/admission): UF undergraduate admission process, requirements, and tuition policies
- [Dates and Deadlines](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/dates-deadlines): UF academic calendar with registration dates and semester deadlines

## Academic Policies and Regulations

- [Academic Regulations](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/academic-regulations): UF undergraduate academic policies, grading, and graduation requirements
- [FERPA and Confidentiality of Student Records](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/academic-regulations/ferpa-confidentiality-student-records): FERPA regulations and UF student records privacy and access policies

## Student Support and Advising

- [Academic Advising](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/academic-advising): UF academic advising services, policies, and student support resources

## Catalog Navigation and Reference

- [A-Z Index](https://catalog.ufl.edu/azindex): Alphabetical index to UF catalog including colleges, programs, and courses

## Optional

- [Previous Catalogs](https://catalog.ufl.edu/UGRD/previous-catalogs): Archive of previous UF undergraduate catalogs by academic year
